list.name: station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "manufacturing", tag: "station", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sim_events" and r.event_type == "ALARM" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.source =~ /${station:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "message" or r._field == "old_state" or r._field == "new_state")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "source", "severity", "message", "old_state", "new_state"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sim_events" and r.event_type == "ALARM" and r._field == "message" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.source =~ /${station:regex}/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with reason: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["reason"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station =~ /${station:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^time_in_state_/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["station"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
